title: 方根與數的分類 — 基礎練習

prompt.en: Find the exact value of this real nth root. Give one number and explain by checking the corresponding power. An even root means the nonnegative root.
prompt.zh: 求這個實數 n 次方根的準確值，填寫一個數，並用相應的乘方核對答案。偶數次方根取非負的值。

hint.en: Which number, multiplied by itself the stated number of times, gives the radicand? Odd powers can be negative; the principal even root is nonnegative.
hint.zh: 哪一個數自乘指定的次數後，會得到被開方數？奇數次乘方可以是負數；偶數次方根則取非負值。

solution.en: The value is 0, because (0)^4 = 0. The radical denotes the nonnegative even root, not a pair of solutions.
solution.zh: 答案是 0，因為 (0)^4 = 0。這個根號取非負的偶數次方根，答案不是一對數。

prompt.en: Choose the value of the displayed expression. Explain the effect of the root sign, any minus sign and any brackets.
prompt.zh: 選出算式的值，並說明根號、負號及括號各自的作用。

hint.en: Read the operation first: taking a square root, negating that root, and squaring a negative number are different operations.
hint.zh: 先看清楚運算：求平方根、取平方根的相反數，以及把負數平方，是不同的運算。

solution.en: (-2)^2 = 4. The brackets make the whole nonpositive number the base of the square.
solution.zh: (-2)^2 = 4。括號表示整個非正數都是平方的底數。

prompt.en: This expression denotes its exact value. Is this number rational or irrational? Choose and give a mathematical reason.
prompt.zh: 這個算式表示其準確值。這個數是有理數還是無理數？請選擇並說明數學理由。

hint.en: A rational number can be written as p/q with integers p, q and q ≠ 0. A root sign does not automatically mean irrational.
hint.zh: 有理數可寫成 p/q，其中 p、q 是整數，而且 q ≠ 0。有根號不一定就是無理數。

solution.en: An integer, a fraction of integers with nonzero denominator, or an exact terminating decimal can be written as a fraction of integers. It is rational.
solution.zh: 整數、分母非零的整數分數，以及準確的有限小數，都可寫成整數之比，所以是有理數。

prompt.en: Between which consecutive integers does this exact number lie? Choose an interval and justify the bounds by comparing squares. Sketch its approximate position in your working.
prompt.zh: 這個數的準確值介乎哪兩個相鄰整數之間？請選出區間，用平方比較說明上下界，並在解題空間畫出它的大約位置。

hint.en: First bound the positive square root using neighbouring integer squares. For its negative, reflect the interval across zero and reverse the order.
hint.zh: 先用相鄰整數的平方，找出非負平方根的上下界。如果原數帶負號，便把區間關於零反射，並注意大小次序。

solution.en: 7² = 49 < 57 < 64 = 8². The positive square root is between 7 and 8. Negating reverses the bounds, giving -8 < the number < -7. A sketch only needs a sensible approximate location; the bounds are exact.
solution.zh: 7² = 49 < 57 < 64 = 8²，所以非負平方根介乎 7 與 8 之間。取相反數後，大小次序倒轉，故原數介乎 -8 與 -7 之間。圖上只需標示合理的大約位置，但上下界是準確的。
